arguments.summary: The p99 latency spike lines up with the connection pool refresh, not with the deploy. Investigate failed jobs in the jobs database and export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. Do not delete any rows.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the pgbouncer logs, check for any connection pool issues. Look into the failed jobs table in the jobs database to identify the root cause of the backlog and export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.
